name: Jiangyin Huaxin Precision Technology Corporation
summary: Jiangyin Huaxin Precision Technology Corporation is engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of precision stamping products. The company's main products are various types of precision stamped iron cores, including cores for new energy vehicle drive motors, micro motors, electrical equipment, and ignition coils. It also produces the precision stamping dies required for its core production and supplies its products to automotive parts manufacturers, motor manufacturers, and electrical equipment manufacturers.
